home.heroText: Welcome to our burger paradise, where every bite is a journey into flavour. Premium ingredients, expertly crafted patties and mouthwatering sauces.
home.adv1Text: Every dish is prepared after you order — never kept under a heat lamp.
home.adv2Text: Prices are calculated by our server at checkout. No hidden fees.
home.adv3Text: Follow your order from the kitchen to your door in real time.
home.adv4Text: Pay in cash on delivery or when you pick up your order.
home.storyText: FoodHub started with a simple idea: a burger should be honest. Fresh buns baked every morning, beef ground in-house and sauces made from scratch. Today our kitchen also rolls sushi and bakes pizza with the same care.
home.ctaTitle: Hungry? We're already firing up the grill.
home.ctaText: Order in a couple of taps and follow every step until it arrives.

about.title: About FoodHub
about.lead: A neighbourhood kitchen obsessed with honest food: fresh buns every morning, beef ground in-house and sauces made from scratch.
about.p1: We started as a small burger grill and grew into a kitchen that also rolls sushi and bakes Neapolitan-style pizza. The rule stayed the same: everything is cooked after you order.
about.p2: Our menu is available in Kazakh, Russian and English, and every order can be followed live from the kitchen to your door.
about.v3: Clear allergen information on every dish
about.demo: FoodHub is a demonstration project. The restaurant, address and menu are sample content.

setup.title: The database is not connected yet
setup.accountText: Your account, order history, addresses and favorites are stored in the database. Until it is connected this section is unavailable — no data is invented.
setup.adminText: The admin dashboard works with real orders, products and analytics. Until the database is connected no made-up numbers are shown here — only the interface structure.
setup.kitchenText: The kitchen display loads new orders from the database every 5 seconds. Until it is connected the columns stay empty and status changes are disabled.
setup.step2Text: Run npm run db:deploy, then npm run db:seed.
setup.step3Text: Set SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL and SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD before seeding.
